newsitem.title: UK: Lufthansa Cargo names Bridges as agent.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo names Bridges as agent.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG, the autonomous cargo division of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, has awarded a worldwide general sales agency contract to Bridges Worldwide, that company said.

Bridges Worldwide managing director Guy Bridges said that under the terms, the UK-based company would provide the airline with wholesale courier services throughout its international route network. It extends an existing UK business link.

"This is a significant contract because it means the 60-plus wholesale courier destinations we sell out of the UK are now also available using Lufthansa Cargo's network out of Frankfurt, which is a key European destination for our customers," he added.
"This offers a wider choice of services and flight times," he said.
Lufthansa Cargo general manager corporate sales, Europe and Africa, Reinhold Korner said that courier traffic was an important part of the company's business, generating year-round volume.
Bridges Worldwide said it is the world's largest independent wholesale courier organisation.
